Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If a vampire with Barrenness on him is banished, then does the
Barrenness count while uncontrolled?

I think not because skill cards do not count while uncontrolled
either.

So you would have pay the original full amount printed on the vampire,
then burn the excess blood off of the vampire when you move it into
the controlled region as its capacity shrinks.
